name: cdr_mimiciv_governance_tags
description: Applies the Unity Catalog tag taxonomy (layer / type / domain / mimic_module / hipaa_identifiability / hl7_confidentiality) to cdr_mimiciv and verifies it. Run with mode=dry_run first, then mode=apply. Not created automatically; import via Workflows > Create job > JSON, or `databricks jobs create --json @governance_job.json`.

tasks.description: Schema, table and column tags on bronze, silver, gold

_notes: Serverless compute by default (no job_clusters block).
run_as needs APPLY TAG on the catalog (cdr_admins or cdr_data_stewards).
With mode=dry_run the verify task still runs real checks and reports gaps; set fail_on_gap=false for a dry-run job.
No schedule. Run after Gold_Build_All so new Gold tables (POE) get tagged.
